episodes.title: IWTK Laura Johnston Kohl: Surviving The Jonestown Massacre
episodes.description: Episode 2 is here featuring Laura Johnston Kohl, author of Jonestown Survivor: An Insiders Look. Laura joins the show to talk about her amazing story and share her incredibly interesting past with the listeners. Her history includes activism in Washington D.C., going to Woodstock, living with the Black Panthers, joining the Peoples Temple, becoming a right hand woman of Jim Jones himself, surviving the Jonestown Massacre, joining another cult, rebuilding her life and so much more! Her compelling story is a can't miss interview. You can contact Laura or or fine out more by going to www.jonestownsurvivor.com, buy her book by clicking on the amazon banner on the I Want To Know home page. A big thank you to the listeners for all the great feedback from episode 1, I'm glad it was such a hit with everyone. Please spread the word with your friends and family and spread the knowledge!
